sloka: ते ऽङ्गदप्रमुखा वीराः प्रहृष्टाश्च मुदा ऽन्विताः ।निपेतुर्हरिराजस्य समीपे राघवस्य च ।। ५.६४.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: te 'ṅgadapramukhā vīrāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca mudā 'nvitāḥ ।nipeturharirājasya samīpe rāghavasya ca ।। 5.64.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada the chief along with the heroic monkeys very joyfully and exuberantly descended close to Sugriva, the king of monkeys and Rama.
